items.q: Are the internet and the World Wide Web the same?
items.correct: No — the internet is the global network; the web is one service on it.
items.misconception: Yes, they are the same thing.
items.random_wrong: The web is bigger than the internet.
items.why: The internet connects computers worldwide; the web (websites) is just one of many services that use it.

items.q: Is Wi-Fi always faster than a wired connection?
items.correct: No — wired (Ethernet) is usually faster and more reliable.
items.random_wrong: Wired and wireless are identical in speed.
items.why: Cables avoid interference and typically beat Wi-Fi for speed and stability.

items.correct: Connects different networks and directs data between them.
items.misconception: Stores all the websites you visit.
items.random_wrong: Is the same as a switch.
items.why: A router links networks (e.g. your home to the internet); a switch connects devices within one network.
